entry.author: Electricity Authority Te Mana Hiko
entry.summary: In this episode, Principal Advisor Carl Billington sits down with Hayden Glass, our General Manager of Wholesale and Supply, to discuss the Authority’s decision to introduce non-discrimination obligations to level the playing field in the wholesale electricity market. Together, they discuss what the obligations involve and what they mean for the market and consumers.
